provider_attestation: Council seat name supplied by parent; no independent model-provider attestation performed.
positive_findings: Local store/embed/train/retrieve authorization is explicit and separated from redistribution rights.
F AND NOT P, whole-instance isomorphism, exact compatible context, full pools, content equality after hashes, filtered exact ranking and deny-first restore policy repair the major draft hazards.
Fixed four-block hierarchy and genuinely learned adapter are distinguished from the legacy hash embedding.
Held-out family splits, synthetic-versus-semantic labels and baseline retention prevent unsupported quality claims.

findings.finding: Revocation invalidates the revoked record and regeneration, but the policy does not state whether a checkpoint trained on revoked-purpose data remains eligible. Every candidate can depend on that checkpoint, even after the source row disappears. Training lineage is recorded but is not part of the serving authorization test.
findings.required_resolution: Specify purpose-specific trained-artifact retention policy. Unless continued use is explicitly permitted by the recorded grant, revoke/quarantine affected adapters and their derived vectors, cancel relevant jobs and retrain from permitted lineage before republishing. Include checkpoint lineage in restore replay and query model eligibility. This is a lifecycle consistency requirement, not a demand for third-party clearance before authorized local training.
findings.acceptance: Train an adapter on two records, revoke a contributing training grant, restore a pre-revocation backup and verify that neither old checkpoint nor its derived vectors serves until policy permits continued use or clean retraining completes.

findings.finding: The validated structured vector-envelope query route does not define how trusted query environment and full witness memberships are obtained. Vector shape/model validation cannot establish witness validity or context compatibility; accepting caller-supplied overlap sets would permit fabricated high overlap. The ban on asserted admission flags does not fully define this query route.
findings.required_resolution: Resolve query pools/context through an authorized immutable server record, or require the same local solver admission pipeline for a structured query. A vector-only external envelope must receive no trusted pool-overlap credit and explicit unavailable status; define its ranking mode rather than implying full three-component evidence. Recheck authorization on referenced query records as well as candidates.
findings.acceptance: Forged same-context and witness-ID envelopes cannot gain positive/negative overlap credit; cross-project query record references are denied.

findings.finding: formal_obligations is empty in the reviewed hash. Retrieval.ready proves cardinalities and Boolean flags but has no own-query or SAT-run link, unlike Evidence.admitPair. Embedding is a Fin 3072 function and vectorWidth is constant: this proves the chosen type width, not concatenation order or component coverage. Current fixed-point score proof covers only default weights. These are legitimate small abstractions but cannot support an unqualified full admission/layout/scoring claim.
findings.required_resolution: Fill exact obligation registry and run the two clean builds. Compose ready membership with the existing own-query/run admission policy or explicitly register that bridge as a trusted implementation condition. Define actual four-block assembly/index placement if claiming layout proof. State clearly that tuned weights and float arithmetic are tested, or add a general normalized-weight proof.
findings.acceptance: Registry exactly names and hashes propositions; evidence reports the narrow theorem claims and lists own-query, block order and tuned float score implementation obligations separately unless proved.

findings.finding: ANN recall against exact filtered search is ambiguous about its target. Four-block cosine candidate retrieval and the final predicate-plus-overlap score can rank differently even with a perfect vector ANN index.
findings.required_resolution: Define candidate recall against exact final-score top-k under identical filters, not only exact vector nearest neighbors. Retain a low-vector/high-overlap regression candidate. Exact all-eligible-row ranking remains the accepted default.

findings.finding: The high-level contract leaves chunk weighting/overlap, token and chunk budgets, adapter family/objective and non-regression rule uninstantiated. This is acceptable as planning but insufficient as the frozen reproducibility manifest for actual training.
findings.required_resolution: Before fitting, pin those choices plus exact model/tokenizer bytes, optimizer/seed/epochs, family manifest, k and relevance targets, validation selection and numeric tolerance. Freeze the promotion rule before evaluating test. Deterministically distinguish successful training from quality improvement.

commercialization.clarification: Unresolved corpus redistribution/commercial rights do not automatically block the user-authorized local ingestion, training and retrieval work. Anonymous structural serialization is not evidence that content may be uploaded or redistributed.
commercialization.production_evidence: Measure corpus acceptance/coverage, exact final-score retrieval quality, end-to-end cost/latency and operational recovery before claims. No market, legal or commercial clearance opinion is made.

review_limits: No production code edited, dependencies installed, corpus transmitted or training run.
Reviewed local supplied files; did not independently verify external model/license/dependency claims or execute Lean.
Theorems rely on faithful identities/flags and trusted solver/projection implementations as documented.
Spec advanced to revision 2 during report creation; this report intentionally binds the fully read revision 1 hash, not concurrently modified content.
next_step: Reconcile the two lifecycle/API blockers and precise formal claims, freeze the new hashes, then request acceptance re-review. Runtime gates and commercial release remain distinct.
